raw_segments.text: The Argives were maddened by this boasting.
Ajax's son of Telamon was more angry than any, for the man had fallen close beside him,
so he aimed at Paladamas as he was retreating, but Paladamas saved himself by swerving aside
and the spear struck Archilachas' son of Antona, for heaven counseled his destruction.
It struck him where the head springs from the neck at the top joint of the spine and
severed both the tendons at the back of the head.
His head, mouth, and nostrils reached the ground long before his legs and knees could
do so, and Ajax shouted to Paladamas, saying,
Think, Paladamas, and tell me truly whether this man is not as well worth killing as Prothiner
was. He seems rich, and of rich family, a brother it may be, or son of the night Antona,
for he is very like him.
